start: Keeper. It's Mara. I can see the whole road from up here.
Machines ahead. Skitters. Keep the truck moving.
Gun's on auto. You just drive. And ram anything that climbs on!
swarm: Big swarm behind that ridge. Brace!
Lots of them, Keeper. Boost through!
They're climbing out of the sand ahead!
dusk: Sun's going down. Park it and dig in.
Night's coming. Build walls, put guns out. Fast.
dawn: Dawn. You made it. Drive on, Keeper.
Sun's up! They're running back into the sand.
stop: Scrap yard on your right. Worth a look.
Pull over there. We need parts.
dead: We're overrun! Keeper, get out of there!
